build_segment_anything_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow DatasetBuilder for the Segment Anything dataset with COCO-style annotations and Apache Beam pipeline
normalize_bbox_coordinates: normalize bounding box coordinates from COCO format to TFDS format with image dimensions
parse_segment_anything_annotations: parse Segment Anything JSON annotations and normalize bounding boxes and crop boxes to TFDS format
generate_segment_anything_examples: generate TFDS examples from image paths and JSON annotation files using Apache Beam pipeline
download_segment_anything_dataset: download and extract Segment Anything dataset files from a tab-separated links file into manual directory
